finding: We tested when paying for a source cue ceases to improve storage. With a cue that is correct two-thirds of the time, acquisition has positive net value in 147 of 420 problems when free, 125 at a fee of 1/64, and 34 at 1/16; none benefits at 1/4. Fees are hypothetical source-probability utility. Independent rational reconstruction and both full replays verify this constructed-method result; forecast accuracy and process correspondence remain unestablished.
